List downloadable assets on a dated Tankan release page

Source: R/tankan.R
list_boj_tankan_assets.Rd

Fetches one dated Tankan comprehensive-data release page and keeps only its official workbook and ZIP links. The page itself can be obtained from list_boj_tankan_releases().

Usage

list_boj_tankan_assets(
  release_url,
  cache_dir = boj_cache_dir(),
  refresh = FALSE,
  offline = FALSE,
  max_age = 24 * 60 * 60,
  timeout = 30,
  retries = 3L,
  wait = 1,
  max_bytes = 8 * 1024^2,
  deadline = NULL
)

Arguments

release_url

A non-empty exact HTTPS URL for an official BOJ Tankan archive page under /statistics/tk/zenyo/, including the optional /en/ language path. It is typically a dated release page returned by list_boj_tankan_releases(), although a root or range index under that path is also accepted and may yield no assets. It is not a local filename or an arbitrary web page.

cache_dir

Directory used for content-addressed response snapshots. The default is tools::R_user_dir("readboj", "cache"); it is created when needed. Use a package-managed temporary directory in tests.

refresh

Logical scalar. If TRUE, ignore an otherwise usable request snapshot and retrieve the catalogue again.

offline

Logical scalar. If TRUE, make no network request and use a valid cached snapshot only; an absent or stale snapshot raises an readboj_offline_error.

max_age

Non-negative cache age in seconds, or Inf for no age limit. The default is 24 hours.

timeout

Non-negative per-request timeout in seconds. The default is 30 seconds.

retries

Non-negative integer number of retries for transient transport responses or errors. The default is 3L.

wait

Non-negative seconds between requests and retries. The default is one second; waiting is skipped for cached responses and offline reads.

max_bytes

Positive maximum response size in bytes. The default is 8 * 1024^2 (8 MiB), and protects the HTML snapshot before parsing.

deadline

Optional single absolute POSIXct/POSIXlt time shared by the request, retries, and waits. When omitted, a bounded deadline is derived from timeout and retries.

Value

A base data.frame with no row names and exactly the character columns id, label, and url. id is the XLS/XLSX/ZIP basename without a query or fragment, label is the published link text, and url is the absolute asset URL. Duplicate rows with the same URL are removed. readboj_provenance() records the page snapshot and the exact release_url used for discovery.

Details

Only URLs ending in .xls, .xlsx, or .zip are retained; notices, PDFs, and other links are deliberately excluded. The release page is fetched over HTTPS from www.boj.or.jp, with successful response bytes cached under cache_dir. offline = TRUE requires a valid page snapshot and makes no network request. This function does not download the listed assets.

Invalid or non-official release_url values, a missing/changed page, transport or HTTP/rate-limit/authentication failures, stale offline data, or parameter/size/deadline violations produce typed readboj errors.

See also

list_boj_tankan_releases(), download_boj_tankan_asset(), read_boj_workbook(), boj_provenance()

Examples

if (identical(Sys.getenv("READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES"), "true")) {
  releases <- list_boj_tankan_releases("en", max_pages = 6L,
    cache_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "readboj-live-example-cache"),
    timeout = 10, retries = 0L, wait = 0, max_bytes = 2 * 1024^2,
    deadline = Sys.time() + 60)
  if (nrow(releases)) {
    assets <- list_boj_tankan_assets(releases$url[[1L]],
      cache_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "readboj-live-example-cache"),
      timeout = 10, retries = 0L, wait = 0, max_bytes = 2 * 1024^2,
      deadline = Sys.time() + 30)
    head(assets)
  }
} else {
  message("Set READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES=true to run this live example.")
}
#> Set READBOJ_LIVE_EXAMPLES=true to run this live example.
